items.description:
Arlecchino by tashas is a Mediterranean restaurant on Regent Road in Sea Point, the newest dining concept from the Tashas Group. Founder and CEO Natasha Sideris describes the restaurant as Mediterranean at heart but guided by instinct rather than rules, with the menu developed by the group's culinary director.

The restaurant offers an all-day, ingredient-driven dining experience tailored to Cape Town's coastal energy, with a dedicated breakfast menu served from 8am to midday. Breakfast options range from a classic three-cheese omelette to more decadent dishes such as panettone French toast.

It suits diners on the Atlantic Seaboard who want a laid-back yet elevated take on Mediterranean food from an established Cape Town restaurant group.

items.description:
Bantry Bay International Vacation Resort is a self-catering apartment resort built into the rocks above the Atlantic surf in Bantry Bay, a short distance from Clifton beach. The apartments are fully equipped, self-contained and serviced, ranging from studio units for two to four guests up to three-bedroom duplex apartments sleeping six to eight, some with tinted skylights.

Guests wake to the sound of the ocean below their private sundeck, and a sun-washed leisure deck and pool sit just metres above the surf, used for sunset cocktails or simply relaxing to the sound of the waves. The resort also operates on a timeshare basis.

It suits guests who want a self-catering stay with ocean views, within easy reach of Sea Point's restaurants and Cape Town's theatres and cultural venues.

Bathroom Bizarre Northgate is a bathroom showroom in Ysterplaat and an official Geberit dealer. The showroom displays Geberit bathroom products including actuator plates and sanitary modules, washbasins and WCs, covering ranges such as the VariForm, ONE, Selnova and Smyle series.

As a Geberit dealer, the showroom can also direct customers to installation and flushing systems, water supply systems and water drainage systems from the brand. Because dealer displays change, the showroom encourages customers to check ahead if they want to see a specific product line in person.

It suits homeowners, builders and renovators in Ysterplaat and the Northgate area who want to see Geberit bathroom fittings before buying.

Bishopsgrace is a five-star guest house on the eastern slopes of Table Mountain in Bishopscourt, overlooking Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens. The secluded, wind-free setting gives easy access to the city while keeping sweeping mountain views, and the guest house is furnished with a timeless, understated sense of style and exquisite detail throughout.

It offers six individually themed suites with private north-facing balconies, two family suites and a small boutique. Rooms are finished in subtle greys and pewter with antique brass pieces and tailored wallpaper, and a floodlit tennis court and two swimming pools complement the mountain views.

Guests can sunbathe on a private terrace overlooking Table Mountain or watch the city lights over sundowners. It suits travellers who want secluded, five-star luxury close to Kirstenbosch and the city.

Blue Downs Clinic is a primary healthcare facility operated by the City of Cape Town, serving the Blue Downs community in the greater Eerste Rivier and Kuilsrivier area. Its core verified services are HIV and ARV treatment, TB screening and treatment, family planning, vaccinations and HIV testing.

The clinic offers same-day ART initiation for patients who bring an ID document and arrive before 10am, and TB screening runs through the DOTS programme, with sputum test results taking two to three days. Family planning services include contraception counselling, and the clinic refers complex cases to Khayelitsha and Eastern Substructure health facilities or Eerste Rivier Hospital.

The facility does not operate 24 hours, and after-hours emergencies are referred to Eerste Rivier Hospital or Karl Bremer Hospital. It suits residents of Blue Downs and the surrounding Cape Flats area who need primary healthcare, family planning or HIV and TB services close to home.

Caroline's Health and Beauty is a spa tucked under a large oak tree in a corner of Noordhoek Farm Village, within smelling distance of the freshly baked bread from the village's Foodbarn Deli and Bakery. The spa offers whole-body care for both ladies and gentlemen, with treatments carried out in private treatment rooms.

Guests can choose from a range of specialised treatments, including facials and body treatments, in a calm setting designed for peace and tranquillity. It makes a relaxing stop after shopping at the village's shops, or while staying at the nearby De Noordhoek Hotel.

The spa suits visitors looking for a short, relaxing escape from Cape Town, close to the farm village's shops and restaurants in Noordhoek.

items.description:
Ellerman House is a luxury hotel in an elegant Edwardian mansion in Bantry Bay, overlooking the Atlantic Ocean about ten minutes from the V&A Waterfront and within walking distance of Clifton and Camps Bay beaches. The property is rated 4.9 out of five from 699 reviews, and guests can choose the opulent main house or the hotel's more modern villas.

The hotel's draws include its South African art collection, gourmet cuisine and a wine cellar holding more than 9,000 bottles. Facilities include a heated outdoor pool, a spa, a fitness room, a sauna, a beauty centre and multi-bedroom villas, with children welcome from age 12 in the main house and no minimum age in the villas.

It suits travellers seeking a five-star stay that combines fine wine, art and ocean views in one of Cape Town's most exclusive suburbs.

Espresso Lab Microroasters is a specialty coffee roastery at The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock. The roastery showcases coffees from fully traceable farms, estates and cooperatives, and works to build direct relationships with growers and exporters on sustainable, fair and equal trade terms.

The team says the coffees it chooses to showcase reflect its own personality, and it is proud to be part of the specialty coffee community that highlights the work of coffee farmers worldwide. The roastery trades from the Mill on weekdays and Saturday mornings.

It suits coffee drinkers who want to taste single-origin, traceable coffee while visiting the Mill's market and design shops in Woodstock.

items.description:
Le Bistrot De JAN is a French bistro at the InterContinental Table Bay in the V&A Waterfront, created by South African chef Jan-Hendrik van der Westhuizen as an ode to the classic French bistro. Dark-blue awnings, cafe tables outside and a midnight-blue interior lit by cascading beaded chandeliers give the space a cosy, elegant feel that is unpretentious but beautiful.

The kitchen is led by chef Giles Edwards, who channels the simple, fresh style of French bistro cooking he and Jan-Hendrik experienced on a trip to Nice. The Cape Town restaurant follows the opening of Le Bistrot De JAN in Nice in 2024, itself a more relaxed sibling of Jan-Hendrik's Michelin-starred Restaurant JAN.

It suits diners who want a taste of the French Riviera, with simple, unfussy cooking, in the heart of the V&A Waterfront.

Miss J'z Hair and Beauty Bar is a hair and beauty salon on 5th Avenue in Lotus River, offering hair treatments including Brazilian and Botox treatments, along with lash and brow services. Services include wash, cut and blow-dry, hair colouring, face waxing and eyebrow and eyelash treatments.

The salon says it prides itself on the service it delivers and on keeping its customers happy, aiming to help clients leave looking and feeling their best. Bookings can be made online with instant confirmation.

It suits clients in Lotus River and nearby Grassy Park who want a hair and beauty appointment, including evening and Sunday slots.

Monster Plumbing is a plumbing company based in Montague Gardens, offering leak detection and repair, water meters and water systems, drain unblocking, geyser installation, and bathroom and kitchen renovations. The company also issues Plumbing Certificates of Compliance and runs a 24-hour emergency line alongside its office number.

Its service area stretches from the Cape Peninsula CBD, Woodstock, Pinelands and Camps Bay to the Northern Suburbs, Southern Suburbs, West Coast towns such as Milnerton and Table View, and the Helderberg and Boland towns including Strand, Somerset West and Stellenbosch. The company is also linked to training institutions, including its own Monster Plumbing College.

It suits homeowners and businesses across greater Cape Town who need a plumber for anything from a blocked drain to a full bathroom renovation.

items.description:
Party Time Somerset West is a party supply store at Fountain Square on Main Road, hiring out and selling items for birthdays and other celebrations. Customers have hired jumping castles, popcorn machines and candy floss machines together at a discounted weekday rate, and the store also sells cupcakes and party buckets for celebrations.

Reviewers describe the shop's hire equipment as neat and well looked after, with friendly, efficient service and good advice from staff on planning a party. The shop is open seven days a week, with shorter hours over the weekend.

It suits parents and event organisers in Somerset West who want decorations, party hire equipment or treats for a birthday or celebration.

Pigalle Cape Town is an event venue and restaurant in the heart of Green Point, describing itself as Cape Town's largest indoor restaurant venue, accommodating more than 350 guests. The space offers live entertainment from a dance floor alongside dinner courses crafted from quality ingredients, in a sophisticated setting.

Beyond dinner service, Pigalle hosts corporate events, private celebrations and larger gatherings, with a balcony overlooking Green Point, disability-friendly access and secure covered parking. The venue enforces a smart casual dress code, with no caps or shorts, to keep its luxurious ambience for all guests.

It suits diners wanting a stylish night out and hosts planning a large event or celebration in Green Point.

items.description:
Ridgemor Villa Guesthouse is a guest house and event venue on a farm in the Winelands near Firgrove, Somerset West, with the farm dating back to 1670. The name Ridgemor, established in 1862, comes from its original owners, Ridge and Morris, and the farm was originally used for tobacco and cattle before it belonged to Zandvliet.

The guesthouse has nine furnished rooms catering for groups, honeymooners, conferences and business stopovers, set in a tranquil garden with its own birdlife. The property regularly hosts music festivals, weddings and other events, and it offers free WiFi and free parking.

It is about 25km from Cape Town International Airport, with the beach, restaurants, golf courses and the Stellenbosch Wine Route all a short drive away. It suits groups and couples who want a private, garden setting for a stay or an event.

Seebamboes is an intimate restaurant on the mezzanine above Galjoen on Harrington Street in District Six, a collaboration between two chef-restaurateurs and a second chef and artist. The name comes from the kelp native to the Great African Seaforest, and the menu reimagines surf and turf with playful, nostalgic dishes built around South African ingredients.

Dishes include kelp spaghetti with exotic mushrooms and Wagyu brisket, and snoek mousse paired with biltong powder and dune spinach, each reflecting a focus on sustainability and local produce. The space seats just 16 diners among high tables and reclaimed materials, with a window framing Table Mountain, and the menu changes with the seasons.

Desserts lean nostalgic too, with reinvented ice-cream sandwiches and a twist on Eskimo pies. It suits diners who want a small, inventive tasting-style meal that treats South African surf and turf as a creative starting point.

items.description:
Somerset West Private School began from extra mathematics tuition offered by its principal, with demand for the classes leading to the school's opening in 1998. It is based in the heart of Somerset West and offers classes from Grade 8 through to Post Matric level.

The Post Matric group is made up of learners wanting to improve their Grade 12 results, many of whom are referred to the school by Stellenbosch University or the University of Cape Town after not meeting the minimum Mathematics and Science requirements for certain degrees, and the course runs for one year. The school says its mission is to discover the potential in every learner, with a focus on empowerment, accountability, responsibility and respect.

It draws learners from the Helderberg basin and beyond, and it suits families looking for a smaller private school with a strong focus on Mathematics and Science.

TAH Kenridge is a veterinary hospital at 78 De Bron Avenue in Kenridge, part of The Animal Hospital Group, which also runs branches in Bellville, Durbanville, Sonstraal and Parow. The practice is listed as a veterinarian, animal hospital, pet supply store and pet trainer, and it opens six days a week with Saturday morning hours.

Reviewers describe caring, thorough treatment, including a dental procedure for a cat and quick, affordable help for an animal bitten by a stray, with clear follow-up feedback after tests. One reviewer noted being seen at short notice with friendly service and no hidden costs.

It suits pet owners in Kenridge and the surrounding northern suburbs who want a nearby veterinary hospital offering both routine and urgent care.

items.description:
The Cutting Room is a hair salon and barber shop on Kommetjie Road in Fish Hoek, open Tuesday to Saturday. Reviewers mention a revamped interior, a Mycro Keratin treatment service, and head massages served alongside good coffee during a visit.

The salon is part of a small group with other branches at Longbeach Mall in Noordhoek and the Glen Alpine Centre in Bergvliet. Reviews are mixed on price, with some clients saying it is worth paying more for the result and others finding it expensive for a smaller town salon.

It suits Fish Hoek residents who want a hair cut or colour treatment with a cafe-style coffee stop built into the visit.

The Glass and Bead Cabin is a shop at The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock, selling beads at retail and wholesale alongside ornamental sand-carved and sandblasted glasswork. Its glass range covers windows, glass table tops, glassware, doors, mirrors, trophies and logos, made to a customer's own design.

The business grew out of a Cape Town family enterprise established in 1982, and it now combines a bead shop with a glass workshop that does flame work, making glass beads and other glass items. Demonstrations of the glass and bead-making process are performed regularly at the shop.

It suits shoppers looking for beads for jewellery-making, or anyone wanting a custom sandblasted design on glass or a mirror.

The Milk Restaurant and Champagne Bar is a three-storey restaurant and bar in Khayelitsha, which launched in 2018 as the first upmarket, multi-storey restaurant and bar of its kind in a township. After a hiatus during the Covid-19 pandemic, it relaunched as The Milk Restaurant and Champagne Bar in 2022.

The venue lets guests wine and dine on one floor and lounge on another within the same building, joining a wave of newer Khayelitsha establishments redefining the township as a tourism and entertainment destination, alongside long-standing venues such as KwaAce and Kefu's Jazz Bar. Khayelitsha itself is known for its entrepreneurial spirit and diverse culture.

It suits visitors who want to see Khayelitsha's growing nightlife scene, with dining, drinks and a lounge atmosphere across its different floors.

The Shred is an indoor skatepark and coffee shop in Paarden Eiland, with a sizeable bowl, quarter pipes and other skate features inside a warehouse. The venue also hosts events and live music, and reviewers describe the coffee shop inside as a good spot for parents to wait while children skate.

Beginners can rent a skateboard and take lessons, and the venue has run free ladies' nights for skaters wanting a safe space to practise. One reviewer praised the venue for stocking sustainable and recycled skate products.

It suits families and skaters of any level who want an indoor skate session, lessons or a coffee while watching from the side, whatever the weather.

4x4 Mega World Cape Town is an outdoor sports and camping store at 26 Marine Drive in Paarden Eiland, listed as an outdoor sports store, camping store and off-road race track. The branch sells 4WD and camping equipment, and reviewers describe staff as friendly and helpful, including one reviewer who named the store manager for going out of his way to assist.

The store is part of a small chain that includes a branch in George, and its online shop offers seasonal clearance sales and a loyalty club called MegaXplore. Some reviews mention the shop feeling smaller than expected for the range on offer, due to limited floor space.

It suits off-road and camping enthusiasts in Cape Town who want to browse 4x4 and camping gear in person before buying.

Agrimark Sitari is a hardware and agricultural supply store at Sitari Village on the corner of the R102 and Sundarbans Drive in Croydon. The branch offers paint mixing, deliveries, building plans, roof truss plans, direct diesel deliveries and product sourcing, along with credit facilities.

Other services include prepaid airtime, data and electricity, key cutting, embroidery, gas swap and refill, and tool hire, plus gift cards and a nursery. The centre also houses a Lounah Cafe and a sit-down Mugg and Bean, and customers can use click and collect for online orders.

It suits builders, farmers and households in the Croydon and Somerset West area who want hardware, building materials and everyday services under one roof.

Bradlows Philippi is a furniture store at The Junxion Mall, selling furniture and appliances for the kitchen, living room, dining room and bedroom. The store is part of a chain that says it has been connecting South Africans with their favourite furnishings for generations, celebrating more than 120 years at the heart of South African homes.

The range at the Philippi branch includes bedroom, lounge, dining and kitchen suites, along with coffee tables, wall units, and audio and TV furniture. The store describes its approach as offering quality furniture and knowledgeable staff at prices customers can afford.

It suits shoppers furnishing a home who want to see furniture in person at a mall close to Philippi.

Buitenverwachting, meaning 'beyond expectations', is a wine farm in the Constantia Valley offering wine tasting, a restaurant, a coffee and deli space called Coffee Bloc, a working studio and a gallery. Its wine range includes the Buiten Blanc white blend, a vineyard-selection Constantia Sauvignon Blanc that draws on the farm's varying terroirs, and a Sauvignon Blanc Chardonnay blend with a fresh, citrus character.

The farm's picnic lawns open each summer, weather permitting, though self-catering picnics are not allowed on them. Wines, tastings and deli items can also be ordered through the farm's online shop.

It suits wine lovers and day-trippers who want tastings, a meal or a picnic on the lawns in the heart of the Constantia wine route.

Cape Blinds and Shutters is a window treatment company based in Epping, serving the Western Cape with blinds, shutters and custom solutions for both residential and commercial spaces. The company says it treats every window as unique, tailoring each installation to match the client's aesthetic and functional needs.

Its focus is on attention to detail and craftsmanship, delivered through a personalised service for each client rather than off-the-shelf products. The business is based at Epping Works on Moorsom Avenue in Epping Industria.

It suits homeowners and businesses across the Western Cape who want blinds or shutters fitted to a specific window shape or style rather than a standard size.

Caterware Connection is the Cape Town branch of Caterware, a professional kitchen equipment supplier based at Maitland Business Park on Mowbray Road. The company designs, supplies, installs and maintains catering equipment, covering planning and design through to ongoing maintenance.

Its product range includes advanced cooking and refrigeration equipment for commercial kitchens, and the company says it serves architects, hotels, restaurants, bars and facility managers across Johannesburg, Cape Town and beyond. Caterware says decades of industry experience and a focus on customer satisfaction have made it a trusted name in professional kitchens.

It suits hospitality businesses and facility managers who need a single supplier for catering equipment, from the design stage through to repairs.

items.description:
Greeff Christie's International Real Estate opened a branch-new office at Noordhoek Farm Village in 2020, choosing the location because the village functions as the centre of the Noordhoek community. The agency's Noordhoek team has a longstanding presence in the area, with one agent working in the business since 1989 and having completed more than 1,000 sales.

The agency says a presence in the community helps it serve both buyers and sellers in the area, and that being transparent with clients helps build long-lasting relationships. The office handles residential sales, rentals, and farms and vacant land in and around Noordhoek.

It suits buyers and sellers in Noordhoek who want agents who live locally and know the area well.

Hangberg Pre-Primary School is a pre-school in Hout Bay that marked ten years of serving its community in 2024. It began in July 2014 with two classrooms on loan from Sentinel Primary School and 60 Grade R children, and has since grown into a purpose-built facility catering for up to 120 pre-schoolers.

Plans for the permanent building were approved during 2014 and 2015, and the school raised R5.5 million to fund construction, with the Rotary Club Am Kap in Sea Point and its German Rotarian partners donating 60% of the cost. The rest came from other donors and the trust's annual dinner dances.

The school serves children from different backgrounds in the Hangberg community, and its activities include swimming lessons. It suits families in Hout Bay looking for a community-rooted pre-school for Grade R-aged children.

items.description:
Ice Cape Town is an ice and cooler box supplier in Paarden Eiland, trading since 2007 and describing itself as Cape Town's premier distributor of packaged ice, craft ice and dry ice. Its factory shop is open to the public, offering wholesale pricing on packaged ice, dry ice, gel ice packs, Buddy Cool cooler boxes, craft ice and La Vie water.

The company delivers seven days a week, including public holidays, across the Cape Town CBD, Atlantic Seaboard, Cape Peninsula and the Northern and Southern Suburbs, using specialised freezer trucks that maintain the cold chain. It also offers event expertise, catering for anything from a 100kg house party to large music and sporting events needing up to 100 tons of ice.

Its products include tube and crushed packaged ice, solid blocks and dry ice pellets and blocks. It suits businesses, event planners and households who need reliable ice supply and delivery in Cape Town.
